mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, c.name AS name, c.address AS address, i.name AS industry, c.registration_number AS registrationNumber, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS unitCount, COUNT(e.id) AS employeeCount FROM companies c LEFT JOIN industries i ON i.id = c.industry_id LEFT JOIN units u ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.unit_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id} GROUP BY c.id, c.name, i.name

SELECT c.id AS id, c.name AS name, c.address AS address, i.name AS industry, c.registration_number AS registrationNumber, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS unitCount, COUNT(e.id) AS employeeCount FROM companies c LEFT JOIN industries i ON i.id = c.industry_id LEFT JOIN units u ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.unit_id = u.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, i.name ORDER BY c.id

SELECT u.id AS id, c.name AS companyName, u.name AS name, t.name AS type, u.code AS code, p.name AS parentName, COUNT(e.id) AS employeeCount FROM units u LEFT JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit_types t ON u.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN units p ON u.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.unit_id = u.id WHERE u.company_id = #{id} AND NOT u.type_id = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.name, c.name, t.name, p.name ORDER BY u.id

SELECT e.id AS id, c.name AS companyName, u.name AS unitName, e.first_name AS firstName, e.last_name AS lastName, p.name AS position, e.email AS email, e.phone AS phone, e.dob AS dob FROM employees e LEFT JOIN units u ON u.id = e.unit_id LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = e.position_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = u.company_id WHERE u.company_id = #{id} GROUP BY e.id, c.name, u.name, p.name ORDER BY e.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO companies (name, address, industry_id, registration_number) VALUES (#{name}, #{address}, #{industryId}, #{registrationNumber})
mapper.update: UPDATE companies SET name = #{name}, address = #{address}, industry_id = #{industryId}, registration_number = #{registrationNumber} WHERE id = #{id}
